title: 100 Locations of Revolving Joy: Kura Sushi USA Reaches Triple-Digit Milestone This December, Celebrating with Dine-In Giveaways and 3X Rewards Points
body_markdown:
# 100 Locations of Revolving Joy: Kura Sushi USA Reaches Triple-Digit Milestone This December, Celebrating with Dine-In Giveaways and 3X Rewards Points


*Nation's largest revolving sushi chain brings new restaurants to Texas and Florida and makes its Kura Reserve menu a monthly event*


***Key Takeaways***


- *Kura Sushi USA, the largest revolving sushi restaurant brand in the U.S., will reach 100 restaurants in December 2026, with new locations opening in Arlington, Texas; and Gainesville, Florida.*
- *Dine-in guests can receive collectibles on Dec. 1, 9 and 21 with a $75 minimum order, and Kura Sushi Rewards members earn 3X Points on eligible orders Dec. 4–6.*
- *Kura Reserve, the brand's limited-time seasonally inspired unique menu, becomes a monthly 10-day drop as the company works toward 17 openings this fiscal year and 300 U.S. restaurants long term.*


November 17, 2026


[Kura Sushi USA, Inc.](https://kurasushi.com/) (NASDAQ: KRUS), the nation's largest revolving sushi restaurant brand, will open its 100th U.S. restaurant in December 2026. To mark the milestone, the company is celebrating by giving dine-in guests collectibles, offering Kura Sushi Rewards members 3X Points on select December dates, and turning its limited-time Kura Reserve menu into a regular monthly event.


**The Road to 100 Restaurants:**


Kura Sushi USA will cross the 100-restaurant mark this December, as its final two openings of the calendar year bring the brand to new communities in Arlington, Texas in November, followed by Gainesville, Florida in December. The milestone caps an accelerating stretch of growth for the brand, which aims to steadily increase the number of new restaurant openings year over year, advancing it closer to its long-term goal of 300 U.S. restaurants that bring authentic Japanese sushi, made with care and served with joy. The brand plans to open 17 new restaurants this fiscal year and has already made strides with three locations since September in Glen Allen, Virginia; West Des Moines, Iowa; and Greenwood Village, Colorado, and an additional seven are under construction.


**New Restaurants Opening in November and December:**


- **Arlington Highlands**
Address: 4000 Arlington Highlands Blvd Suite 133, Arlington, TX 76018
Opening: November 2026
- **Butler Plaza**
Address: 3830 SW Archer Rd Suite 20, Gainesville, FL 32608
Opening: December 2026


"Reaching 100 restaurants is a milestone that belongs to our guests and to our teams across the country," said Hajime "Jimmy" Uba, President and CEO of Kura Sushi USA, Inc. "As we grow toward 300 locations, we’ll keep scaling responsibly and bringing our mix of quality, authenticity, and innovation for more communities to create joyful moments at Kura Revolving Sushi Bar."


Kura Sushi USA proudly acknowledges ABC Imaging, Autec, Crisp Imaging, Edward Don & Company, JFC International, Mutual Trading Company, Square, and Suzumo, for their unwavering commitment and steadfast support throughout this journey.


**December Dine-In Giveaways:**


Dine-in guests who spend $75 or more will receive a collectible on each of the following dates, while supplies last*:


- **Dec. 1:** Mutenmaru Squishy Surprise Box
- **Dec. 9:** Scratch-off card
- **Dec. 21:** Commemorative puzzle


**3X Points for Kura Sushi Rewards Members:**


Kura Sushi Rewards members can earn extra points during the first weekend of December:


- **Dec. 4–6:** Earn 3X points on eligible dine-in, takeout, and delivery orders placed directly with Kura Sushi**


**Kura Reserve Becomes a Monthly Menu Drop:**


With the expansion of Kura Reserve, Kura Sushi is providing guests with ongoing opportunities to experience unique sushi selections. Designed to complement the restaurant's always-on core menu, this limited-time seasonally inspired culinary platform will now return every month as a 10-day release alongside the core menu. The next drop begins Dec. 11 and will be available at participating locations nationwide for dine-in only, while supplies last.


To find a Kura Revolving Sushi Bar location and make a reservation, visit **[kurasushi.com](https://kurasushi.com/)** and download the **[Kura Sushi Rewards app](https://kurasushi.com/rewards)** to roll into delicious loyalty perks.


**Availability may differ by location and is not guaranteed.*


***3X Points offer valid from 12:00 a.m. local time on December 4 through 11:59 p.m. local time on December 6, 2026, based on the local time zone of the participating restaurant, for enrolled Kura Sushi Rewards members. Members earn three times their standard tier-based Redeemable Points and Status Qualifying Points on qualifying purchases: 30 points per eligible $1 for Yellowfin Tuna, 33 points per eligible $1 for Bigeye Tuna and 36 points per eligible $1 for Bluefin Tuna. “3X Points” represents the standard points earned plus two times the standard points as bonus points. Members must check in using their Kura Sushi Rewards app with each qualifying purchase to earn points. Offer valid on qualifying dine-in purchases and eligible pickup or delivery orders placed directly through the Kura Sushi Rewards app or Kura Sushi’s online ordering platform. Orders placed through third-party ordering or delivery platforms are excluded. Additional exclusions and restrictions may apply.*


**About Kura Sushi USA, Inc.**


Kura Sushi USA, Inc. is the nation’s largest brand of revolving sushi restaurants that serves authentic Japanese cuisine and delivers a joyful dining experience with more than 90 locations in 25 states and Washington D.C. Utilizing advanced innovation to enhance service speed and accuracy, guests have a wide variety of more than 100 menu items at their fingertips via conveyor belt service inclusive of sushi, sashimi, tempura, noodles, desserts, and more, made with high-quality ingredients free of artificial colorings, preservatives, seasonings and sweeteners. Kura Sushi USA, Inc. was established in 2008 as a subsidiary of Kura Sushi, Inc., a Japan-based revolving sushi chain with more than 600 restaurants internationally and 45 years of brand history. For more information about Kura Sushi USA, visit[kurasushi.com](https://kurasushi.com/) , follow Kura Sushi USA on[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/kurasushiusa) ,[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kurasushi_usa/) ,[TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@kurasushiusa) &[X](https://x.com/kurasushi_usa) , and download the[Kura Sushi Rewards app](https://kurasushi.com/rewards) to make a reservation and roll into delicious loyalty perks.
